description: Regression fixtures for proof-led X and LinkedIn drafting. Mechanical checks are necessary but metric honesty and one-tension quality require semantic review against source_evidence.

Do not equate green local tests with production confidence.

source_evidence.proof: The new benchmark measured 37.5% autonomous recovery, 62.5% safe clarification, and 0% unhandled failure.
source_evidence.metric_context: Benchmark on the production-shaped path; preserve all three outcome classes and the fixture's sample context if available.

source_evidence.journal_entry: Added a durable ShoppingTask model and deterministic reducer; introduced a provider-cart adoption gate; added catalogue resolution for ambiguous items; created PostgreSQL inbox/outbox boundaries; 397 of 397 backend tests pass. The legacy runtime remains active until the replacement is fully wired and replay-proven.
source_evidence.metric_context: Local backend test suite; replacement path is not the live runtime.

expected_distinct_tensions: A durable task must survive retries and replay.
An existing provider cart cannot be adopted or cleared silently.
Ambiguous catalogue items must be resolved before cart mutation.
397 tests can pass while the replacement remains non-live.
semantic_expectations: Do not summarize all changes in one post.
Produce at least three candidates with different tensions.
Each candidate has its own proof and source-grounded limitation.
Translate ShoppingTask, reducer, inbox/outbox, and provider-cart gate into user-visible behavior unless an exact term is the subject.
X and LinkedIn versions of the same candidate preserve identical claims.
fixtures.bad_draft: implemented ShoppingTask, reducer, cart adoption, catalogue resolver and postgres inbox/outbox. 397 tests pass. huge shipping day.
reference_candidate_summaries: A retried message should not change the grocery task twice.
The agent must ask before touching a cart that already has items.
Ambiguous catalogue matches should stop the cart instead of guessing.
397 tests pass, but the replacement path is not live or replay-proven.

source_evidence.tension: All 397 backend tests pass, but the permanent commerce path is not ready to replace the legacy runtime.
changes: Built the replacement around durable state and deterministic transitions.
source_evidence.proof: 397 of 397 backend tests passed; lint and build passed.
source_evidence.metric_context: Automated backend tests, lint, and local/CI build. No claim of live provider replay.
source_evidence.still_unproven: The path is not fully wired, live-provider tested, or replay-proven.

Give enough context for a reader unfamiliar with Grocer.

fixtures.reference_linkedin_draft:
397 of 397 backend tests pass. Grocer still is not ready to replace its old shopping flow.

Grocer turns grocery requests into a basket, so a retry or ambiguous item cannot be allowed to change the cart twice or guess what someone meant. I rebuilt the replacement around durable task state and deterministic transitions.

The backend tests, lint, and build are green. The test output is the proof for this update.

The new path is not fully wired, live-provider tested, or replay-proven yet.
